ex: The ball deflected off Reid's body into the goal.
球打在里德身上反弹进球门。

zh: （常指击中某物后）突然转向，偏斜，偏离
en: a sudden change in the direction that something is moving in, usually after it has hit something; the act of causing something to change direction
ex: the angle of deflection
偏斜度

zh: 奸污（处女）；夺去（女子）的贞操
en: to have sex with a woman who has not had sex before

zh: 除去（汽车玻璃上的）雾水
en: to remove the condensation from a car’s windows so that you can see clearly

zh: 落叶剂（有时用作军事武器）
en: a chemical that removes the leaves from plants, sometimes used as a weapon in war
to destroy the leaves of trees or plants, especially with chemicals
the act of destroying the leaves of trees or plants, especially with chemicals

zh: 砍掉（某地）的树林；毁掉（某地）的森林
en: to cut down and destroy all the trees in a place
ex: Two thirds of the region has been deforested in the past decade.
在过去十年里这个地区的森林有三分之二被毁掉。

en: the act of cutting down or burning the trees in an area
ex: land erosion caused by widespread deforestation
广泛的森林砍伐造成的土地侵蚀

zh: 改变…的外形；损毁…的形状；使成畸形
en: to change or damage the usual or natural shape of something; to become changed in shape
ex: The disease had deformed his spine.
疾病导致他脊柱变形。

en: the process or result of changing or damaging the normal shape of something
ex: the deformation of the human body in much Cubist art
立体派艺术中人体的变形

en: having a shape that is not normal because it has grown wrongly
ex: She was born with deformed hands.
她的双手天生畸形。

en: a condition in which a part of the body is not the normal shape because of injury, illness or because it has grown wrongly
ex: Drugs taken during pregnancy may cause physical deformity in babies.
妊娠期服用的药物可能引起婴儿身体畸形。

zh: （英国）环境、食品和乡村事务部
en: the British government department in charge of the environment, farming and food production. It replaced the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Food in 2001.
